hooks.statusMessage: Running unit tests after src/ edit...
hooks.command: export PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH"; f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); case "$f" in */rifugio-website/src/*) cd /Users/alberto.marsanasco/claude_home/rifugio-website && out=$(npm run test:unit --silent 2>&1); rc=$?; if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then echo "Unit tests FAILED after edit to $f:" >&2; echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; fi ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac

hooks.statusMessage: Watching CI run after git push...
hooks.command: export PATH="/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH"; cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); case "$cmd" in *"git push"*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; cd /Users/alberto.marsanasco/claude_home/rifugio-website || exit 0; branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD); sha=$(git rev-parse HEAD); rid=""; for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6; do rid=$(gh run list --branch "$branch" --commit "$sha" --limit 1 --json databaseId -q '.[0].databaseId' 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$rid" ] && break; sleep 5; done; if [ -z "$rid" ]; then echo "Nessun run CI trovato per $sha dopo il push (watch saltato)." >&2; exit 0; fi; out=$(gh run watch "$rid" --exit-status --compact 2>&1); rc=$?; if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then echo "CI run FAILED dopo git push (run $rid):" >&2; echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; fi; echo "CI run passed (run $rid)."
